author: Puffball Comics
title: Artist Call for Line Art Finishing - Abida Issue #2
content: 📢📢 ARTIST CALL FOR ABIDA📢📢 Doston, Puffball Comics is officially on a hunt for an exceptional Line Art Finishing Artist to join the production team for @theabidacomic Issue #2 We're looking for someone who can smoothly step into an established visual world and help us complete pages while maintaining the style, character, and energy of the graphic novel. What you'll be working on: ○ Finishing and refining line art / inks ○ Supporting the completion of illustrated pages ○ Adding shadows, lighting, and finishing touches ○ Working from existing artwork, layouts, and visual references under Lead Artist's direction You should apply if you have strong character drawing and anatomy skills... If this sounds like you, send us your portfolio at contact@puffball.pk
